Encrypted, from one Volta to another nearby
This device has no Bluetooth LE, so it can\'t send or receive links this way.
Volta uses Bluetooth only while this window is open: to find the other device and pass the link. It does not use your location.
On this Android version, finding Bluetooth devices needs the location permission. Volta does not use your location; it only searches while this window is open.
Turn it on to reach the other device. You can turn it off again afterwards.
On this Android version, Bluetooth devices can only be found with location on. Volta doesn\'t read where you are.
On the other device, open Volta → Add → Receive via Bluetooth
On the phone, open a subscription or a server and choose “Send via Bluetooth”
Choose the device that shows a code
Choose the device that is sending
Keep the devices close, with Bluetooth on and Volta open on both.
On the phone, choose “Send via Bluetooth” and pick this device
Connected to %1$s. Waiting for it to confirm the code
The other screen must show the same code
Compare it with the code on %1$s
%1$s has the link and will offer to add it.

Volta no longer has access to nearby devices.

Couldn\'t search for devices. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
The connection broke. Bring the devices closer and try again.
That device isn\'t waiting for a link from Volta.
The codes were different, so the link was not sent: another device may have answered. Try again.
